name: Tod's Omotesando Building
note: Harajuku (9235302289).jpg (2736x3648) is a clear upward view of the branching concrete facade (checked visually). Omotesando buildings.jpg (4608x3456) shows Tod's on the right beside the Keyaki Building. Other files in the category are under 1200px.

name: Tossols-Basil Athletics Track
note: Seven CC0 photos (2048x1536) from 2012: 003/004 show the running track ('Laufbahn'), 001/002 the Corten entrance, 005/006 floodlight masts, 007 the attached football field. Judged from descriptions and category, not viewed.

name: Tropicana Arcos de Cristal

extras.file: File:Havana - Tropicana's famous Crystal Arch Room.jpg

note: No free exterior photo: the 58 files in the category are shows, dancers, a wall plaque and 1950s postcards; the only file named for the Arcos (666px) is too small. The two postcards listed as extras are coloured interior illustrations of the arch hall (PD, about 1500-1600px). Sources agree on five thin concrete shells decreasing in size with glass between, but describe them as placed eccentrically and I could not establish how they offset or step from the outside, so I did not draw it.

name: Tulou Collective Housing
view: slightly raised view of the six-storey round outer ring, its facade screen shown as a grid, with the open courtyard visible inside the top edge
note: No Commons files found (searched English and Chinese names). Sources give a cylindrical outer block of 6 storeys wrapped in a concrete screen with wooden inserts, and a rectangular inner block linked by bridges. The inner block is left out because its height is not documented; the grid spacing is schematic.

name: Umbrella House (Kasa no Ie)
note: Eleven CC0 photos from June 2022 (4032x3024) of the house as re-erected on the Vitra Campus, plus two CC BY-SA 4.0 photos from 2025. Some of the 2022 series may be interiors; pick exterior frames when choosing.

name: Unidad Vecinal Portales

photos.file: File:Unidad Vecinal Portales, Estación Central, Santiago 20230520 01.jpg
File:Unidad Vecinal Portales, Estación Central, Santiago 20230520 02.jpg

note: About 17 large CC BY-SA 4.0 photos in the category (2019, 2023, 2024 series). A few files in the category show neighbouring things (a church, a street sign, a memorial).

name: Vertical Courtyard Apartments

photos.file: File:Qianjiang Times (Vertical Gardens), designed by Wangshu, 2015-02-14.JPG

note: One file (5472x3648, 2015): the project's Chinese name 钱江时代 (Qianjiang Times), 'vertical courtyards, designed by Wang Shu'. Checked visually: it shows the group of white towers across a canal, with a crane and trees in the foreground. It is a distant group view rather than a close facade shot. No dedicated category; the file sits directly in Category:Buildings by Wang Shu.

name: Villa Verde Housing
view: street elevation of three row houses as handed over: each steep gable has its built two-storey half (with door and windows) and an empty half under the same roof
note: No Commons category or files found. Sources confirm two-storey row houses, half built and half left for residents to fill (57 m2 growing to about 85 m2), under a pitched roof. Window positions are schematic; the number of houses shown (three) is illustrative of the row.

name: Xylem
view: side elevation: the thick round-topped canopy of upright pine logs in hexagonal frames, on five of its seven steel columns, over the circular platform and low curved bench
note: No Commons files found. Sources: logs bundled in a modular hexagonal weathering-steel frame on seven steel columns, rounded top profile, circular concrete platform with curved wooden seating, about 2,100 sq ft. Canopy thickness and column height are estimated from that footprint.

name: wNw Bar

photos.file: File:Cà phê Gió và Nước ở Bình Dương (1).JPG
File:Cà phê Gió và Nước ở Bình Dương (3).JPG

note: File (1) (2048x1536, 2014) clearly shows the thatched dome of the wNw Bar rising from the water (checked visually); its description names the bar and its ARCASIA gold award. File (3) is from the same site, not viewed. A third file in the series is an interior. There is no dedicated category; the files sit in Category:Vo Trong Nghia Architects.

name: Disney Ice (Anaheim Ice)
note: Only one file: Anaheimice.jpg, 2272x1704, described as 'Exterior view of Anaheim Ice (formerly Disney Ice)'. Its licence is the Commons 'Attribution' template (free use with credit, equivalent in effect to CC BY), not a numbered CC licence; the owner may want to confirm that is acceptable.

name: The Index
note: The Index Tower - panoramio.jpg (2448x3264, Aidas U.) is a full-height street view of the tower with Emirates Towers behind (checked visually). It is not yet in Category:The Index (Dubai), which holds only two other, weaker files.
